system.description: You can cause spirits to inhabit objects, or fetishes, which you may then carry around with you. Once the spirit is imprisoned, the fetish allows you access to one and only one power (not exceeding Advanced level) that the spirit possesses, determined by the Storyteller. A successful Mental Challenge against the victim is all that is required to bind the spirit to the fetish, and the spirit is trapped until the fetish is broken. Before you may access any power of the fetish, you must permanently expend a Mental Trait to attune the item to yourself.
